"""Exact source-gated original Native right-pass entrypoint."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from package_spec import AID, ACTOR, CAMERA_NAMES, CELL, LAW
from right_pass import construct


def reviewed_site(path, case):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    site = json.loads(path.read_text())
    if site.get("reviewed_original_native_site") is not True or \
            site.get("source_kind") != "original_native_map_geometry" or \
            site.get("assignment_id") != AID or site.get("case_id") != case:
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact Native right-pass site required")
    if not site.get("map_name") or not site.get("map_sha256") or \
            site.get("duration_frames") != 900 or site.get("rate_hz") != 20 or \
            tuple(site.get("cameras", ())) != CAMERA_NAMES:
        raise ValueError("source map and four-view capture profile required")
    refs = site.get("source_refs")
    roles = {"map", "paved_surface_classification", "paved_boundary", "connected_corridor", "actor_poses", "road_frame"}
    if not isinstance(refs, list) or not roles <= {r.get("role") for r in refs}:
        raise ValueError("reviewed right-pass source classes missing")
    for ref in refs:
        target = (path.parent / ref["path"]).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(path.parent) or not target.is_file() or \
                hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("reviewed source hash changed: " + ref.get("role", "unknown"))
    if site["map_sha256"] != next(r["sha256"] for r in refs if r["role"] == "map"):
        raise ValueError("Native map source differs")
    request = construct(site, case)
    site["reviewed_site_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return site, request


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--site", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host")
    parser.add_argument("--port")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "config.json").read_text())
    case = config["selected_case_id"]
    if (config["assignment_id"], config["law_id"], config["cell_id"], config["actor"]) != \
            (AID, LAW, CELL, ACTOR) or args.case not in (None, case):
        raise ValueError("exact selected right-pass case differs")
    if args.check:
        print("exact right-pass runner static check passed: " + case)
        return
    site_path = args.site or os.environ.get("C182383_REVIEWED_SITE")
    if not site_path or not args.host or not args.port or args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed Native site, host, port and output required")
    site, request = reviewed_site(site_path, case)
    from right_pass_carla_adapter import CarlaRightPassAdapter
    from right_pass_capture import capture
    capture(CarlaRightPassAdapter(args.host, args.port, site, request,
                                  config.get("control_profile", {})),
            site, case, args.output_dir)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Materialized case identity and source-gated runner smoke test."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class BundleTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_case_static_runner(self):
        config = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
        self.assertTrue(config["selected_case_id"].startswith(config["assignment_id"] + "__"))
        self.assertEqual((config["rate_hz"], config["duration_s"]), (20, 45))
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runner.py"), "--check"],
                                cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("static check passed", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Capture source-sealed 900-frame right-side passing motion and four cameras."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

from package_spec import AID, CAMERA_NAMES
from right_pass_envelope import measure_data


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def capture(adapter, site, case, destination):
    destination = Path(destination).resolve()
    need(not destination.exists() and ".runtime-work" in destination.parts,
         "original attempt belongs under .runtime-work")
    need(getattr(adapter, "native_attested", False) is True,
         "attested Native CARLA adapter required")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="right-pass-original-", dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        adapter.configure()
        adapter.spawn()
        folders = {name: stage / ("frames-" + name) for name in CAMERA_NAMES}
        for folder in folders.values():
            folder.mkdir()
        rows, mapping, trace = [], [], []
        prior = None
        for index in range(900):
            frame, time_s = adapter.tick()
            need(type(frame) is int and type(time_s) in (float, int),
                 "original Native frame/time missing")
            if prior is not None:
                need(frame == prior[0] + 1 and abs(time_s - prior[1] - .05) <= .002,
                     "original Native 20 Hz cadence differs")
            prior = frame, time_s
            row = adapter.read(frame, time_s)
            need(row.get("frame") == frame and row.get("time_s") == time_s and
                 len(row.get("actor_ids", ())) in (2, 3),
                 "original right-pass actors/frame missing")
            row["native_frame"] = frame
            row["frame"] = index
            row["time_s"] = index / 20
            images = adapter.pixels(frame)
            need(set(images) == set(CAMERA_NAMES), "four original cameras required")
            hashes = {}
            for name in CAMERA_NAMES:
                raw = images[name].get("png")
                need(images[name].get("frame") == frame and isinstance(raw, bytes) and
                     raw.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"),
                     "original camera frame or pixels missing: " + name)
                (folders[name] / f"{index:04d}.png").write_bytes(raw)
                hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            rows.append(row)
            mapping.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": frame,
                            "native_frame": frame, "time_s": index / 20,
                            "camera_png_sha256": hashes})
            position = row["ego_position_xyz_m"]
            trace.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": index / 20,
                          "position_m": position,
                          "position": dict(zip(("x", "y", "z"), position)),
                          "heading_deg": row["ego_heading_deg"],
                          "speed_mps": row["ego_speed_mps"],
                          "speed_mph": row["ego_speed_mps"] / .44704})
        (stage / "video_frames.jsonl").write_text(
            "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in mapping))
        (stage / "trace.jsonl").write_text(
            "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in trace))
        history = {"source_kind": "original_native_actor_history",
                   "assignment_id": AID, "case_id": case,
                   "variant": case.removeprefix(AID + "__"),
                   "map_source_kind": "original_native_map_geometry",
                   "map_sha256": site["map_sha256"],
                   "public_highway": site["public_highway"],
                   "paved_surface_classified": site["paved_surface_classified"],
                   "adjacent_surface_classified": site["adjacent_surface_classified"],
                   "paved_surface_source": site["paved_surface_source"],
                   "paved_boundary_source": site["paved_boundary_source"],
                   "connected_route_source": site["connected_route_source"],
                   "driver_actor_id": site["driver_actor_id"],
                   "overtaken_actor_source": site["overtaken_actor_source"],
                   "camera_profile": "overview1080-capability",
                   "reviewed_site_sha256": site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
                   "actor_ids": rows[0]["actor_ids"], "samples": rows}
        put(stage / "right-pass-history.json", history)
        envelope = {"assignment_id": AID,
                    "original_trace_id": site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
                    "ego_actor_id": rows[0]["actor_ids"][0],
                    "overtaken_actor_id": rows[0]["actor_ids"][1],
                    "expected_pass": site["requested_right_pass"],
                    "frames": []}
        for row in rows:
            ego_s, ego_y = row["ego_body_s_bounds_m"], row["ego_body_y_bounds_m"]
            target_s, target_y = row["target_body_s_bounds_m"], row["target_body_y_bounds_m"]
            paved = row["paved_y_bounds_m"]
            envelope["frames"].append({"time_s": row["time_s"],
                "ego_left_m": ego_y[0], "ego_right_m": ego_y[1],
                "overtaken_left_m": target_y[0], "overtaken_right_m": target_y[1],
                "paved_left_m": paved[0], "paved_right_m": paved[1],
                "longitudinal_overlap": max(ego_s[0], target_s[0]) <= min(ego_s[1], target_s[1]),
                "ego_ahead_of_overtaken": ego_s[0] > target_s[1]})
        put(stage / "right-pass-envelope.json", envelope)
        try:
            put(stage / "right-pass-measurement.json", measure_data(envelope))
        except ValueError as error:
            put(stage / "right-pass-measurement.json", {"measured": False,
                "physical_gap": str(error), "legal_safety_judgment": "unresolved"})
        videos = {}
        for name, folder in folders.items():
            video = stage / (name + ".mkv")
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-framerate", "20",
                            "-i", str(folder / "%04d.png"), "-frames:v", "900",
                            "-c:v", "ffv1", str(video)], check=True,
                           stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            videos[name] = {"path": video.name, "sha256": sha(video),
                            "frame_count": 900}
            shutil.rmtree(folder)
        put(stage / "original-source-receipt.json", {
            "source_kind": "original_native_capture", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "case_id": case, "fps": 20, "frame_count": 900,
            "reviewed_site_sha256": site["reviewed_site_sha256"],
            "history_sha256": sha(stage / "right-pass-history.json"),
            "trace_sha256": sha(stage / "trace.jsonl"),
            "frame_map_sha256": sha(stage / "video_frames.jsonl"),
            "measurement_sha256": sha(stage / "right-pass-measurement.json"),
            "envelope_sha256": sha(stage / "right-pass-envelope.json"),
            "cameras": videos, "physical_acceptance": False, "legal_verdict": None})
        os.replace(stage, destination)
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    finally:
        adapter.cleanup()

"""Independently verify original right-pass source joins and full camera decode."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from package_spec import CAMERA_NAMES


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]


def decode(path):
    info = json.loads(subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
        "-show_entries", "stream=nb_frames,r_frame_rate", "-of", "json", str(path)],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
    stream = info["streams"][0]
    need(stream.get("nb_frames") == "900" and stream.get("r_frame_rate") == "20/1",
         "original camera frame rate/count differs")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-i", str(path),
                    "-f", "null", "-"], check=True, capture_output=True)


def audit(attempt, case):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    receipt_path = attempt / "original-source-receipt.json"
    need(receipt_path.is_file(), "original right-pass source receipt missing")
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    need(receipt.get("source_kind") == "original_native_capture" and
         receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False and
         receipt.get("case_id") == case and receipt.get("fps") == 20 and
         receipt.get("frame_count") == 900, "original source receipt differs")
    for name, key in (("right-pass-history.json", "history_sha256"),
                      ("trace.jsonl", "trace_sha256"),
                      ("video_frames.jsonl", "frame_map_sha256"),
                      ("right-pass-measurement.json", "measurement_sha256"),
                      ("right-pass-envelope.json", "envelope_sha256")):
        path = attempt / name
        need(path.is_file() and sha(path) == receipt.get(key),
             "original right-pass source hash differs: " + name)
    history = json.loads((attempt / "right-pass-history.json").read_text())
    trace = rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")
    mapping = rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    need(history.get("case_id") == case and len(history.get("samples", ())) ==
         len(trace) == len(mapping) == 900, "original whole maneuver incomplete")
    need(history.get("public_highway") is True and history.get("paved_surface_classified") is True and
         history.get("adjacent_surface_classified") is True and history.get("paved_surface_source") and
         history.get("paved_boundary_source") and history.get("connected_route_source") and
         history.get("driver_actor_id") and history.get("overtaken_actor_source"),
         "separate classified surface, corridor and actor sources missing")
    prior = None
    for i, (body, motion, frame) in enumerate(zip(history["samples"], trace, mapping)):
        need(body.get("frame") == frame.get("video_frame") == i and
             body.get("native_frame") == motion.get("frame") ==
             frame.get("native_frame") == frame.get("carla_frame") and
             body.get("time_s") == motion.get("time_s") == frame.get("time_s") and
             body.get("actor_ids") == history.get("actor_ids"),
             "original actor/trace/video frame join differs")
        if prior is not None:
            need(frame["native_frame"] == prior[0] + 1 and
                 abs(frame["time_s"] - prior[1] - .05) <= .002,
                 "original right-pass frame cadence differs")
        prior = frame["native_frame"], frame["time_s"]
    cameras = receipt.get("cameras")
    need(isinstance(cameras, dict) and set(cameras) == set(CAMERA_NAMES),
         "four original cameras missing")
    for name, ref in cameras.items():
        path = (attempt / ref["path"]).resolve()
        need(path.parent == attempt and path.is_file() and sha(path) == ref["sha256"] and
             ref.get("frame_count") == 900, "original camera hash differs: " + name)
        decode(path)
    return {"format": "right-pass-original-source-audit", "case_id": case,
            "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt_path), "frame_count": 900,
            "full_decode": True, "actual_pixels_reviewed": False,
            "source_verified": True, "legal_verdict": None}

"""Lazy CARLA bridge for reviewed right-side passing actors and cameras."""

import hashlib
import io
import math
from queue import Queue

from package_spec import CAMERA_NAMES
from right_pass import spawn_native


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


class CarlaRightPassAdapter:
    native_attested = True

    def __init__(self, host, port, site, request, profile):
        import carla
        self.carla = carla
        self.client = carla.Client(str(host), int(port))
        self.client.set_timeout(20)
        self.world = self.client.get_world()
        self.settings = self.world.get_settings()
        self.site, self.request, self.profile = site, request, profile
        self.owned, self.actors, self.queues = [], {}, {}
        frame = site.get("road_frame")
        need(isinstance(frame, dict) and len(frame.get("origin_xy", ())) == 2 and
             len(frame.get("station_axis_xy", ())) == 2 and
             len(frame.get("left_axis_xy", ())) == 2 and frame.get("source_id"),
             "source-surveyed Native road frame missing")
        self.frame = frame

    def pose(self, values):
        c = self.carla
        return c.Transform(c.Location(x=values[0], y=values[1], z=values[2]),
                           c.Rotation(pitch=values[3], yaw=values[4], roll=values[5]))

    def configure(self):
        native_map = self.world.get_map()
        need(native_map.name == self.site["map_name"] and
             hashlib.sha256(native_map.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest() ==
             self.site["map_sha256"], "original Native OpenDRIVE source differs")
        settings = self.world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        self.world.apply_settings(settings)

    def spawn(self):
        spawned = spawn_native(self.world, self.world.get_blueprint_library(),
                               self.site, self.request, self.pose)
        self.actors = spawned
        self.owned.extend(self.actors.values())
        for role in ("ego", "target"):
            actor = self.actors[role]
            heading = actor.get_transform().rotation.yaw
            speed = self.request["ego_speed_mps" if role == "ego" else "target_speed_mps"]
            actor.set_target_velocity(self.carla.Vector3D(
                x=speed * math.cos(math.radians(heading)),
                y=speed * math.sin(math.radians(heading)), z=0))
        offsets = {"overview": (-15, 0, 22), "approach": (-10, 4, 6),
                   "reference_corner": (3, 5, 6), "driver_reference": (0, 0, 2)}
        for index, name in enumerate(CAMERA_NAMES):
            blueprint = self.world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            width, height = ((1920, 1080) if index == 0 else (1280, 720))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(width))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(height))
            blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", "0.05")
            sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(blueprint,
                self.carla.Transform(self.carla.Location(*offsets[name])),
                attach_to=self.actors["ego"])
            queue = Queue()
            sensor.listen(queue.put)
            self.owned.append(sensor)
            self.queues[name] = queue

    def control(self):
        scale = float(self.profile.get("speed_scale", 1))
        need(.5 <= scale <= 1.2, "physical controller scale out of bounds")
        _, ego_y = self.body(self.actors["ego"])
        lateral_now = sum(ego_y) / 2
        lateral_error = self.request["ego_target_lateral_m"] - lateral_now
        lateral_gain = float(self.profile.get("lateral_gain", .055))
        need(.03 <= lateral_gain <= .09, "lateral controller gain out of bounds")
        for role in ("ego", "target"):
            actor = self.actors[role]
            velocity = actor.get_velocity()
            speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)
            target = self.request["ego_speed_mps" if role == "ego" else "target_speed_mps"] * scale
            actor.apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(
                throttle=max(0, min(.65, (target - speed) * .22)),
                brake=max(0, min(.65, (speed - target) * .24)),
                steer=max(-.45, min(.45, lateral_error * lateral_gain)) if role == "ego" else 0))

    def tick(self):
        self.control()
        frame = self.world.tick()
        snapshot = self.world.get_snapshot()
        need(snapshot.frame == frame, "Native frame identity differs")
        return frame, snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds

    def coordinates(self, vertex):
        x = vertex.x - self.frame["origin_xy"][0]
        y = vertex.y - self.frame["origin_xy"][1]
        station = x * self.frame["station_axis_xy"][0] + y * self.frame["station_axis_xy"][1]
        lateral = -(x * self.frame["left_axis_xy"][0] + y * self.frame["left_axis_xy"][1])
        return station, lateral

    def body(self, actor):
        vertices = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())
        bottom = min(v.z for v in vertices)
        points = [self.coordinates(v) for v in vertices if abs(v.z - bottom) <= .01]
        need(len(points) == 4, "four original body corners missing")
        return ([min(v[0] for v in points), max(v[0] for v in points)],
                [min(v[1] for v in points), max(v[1] for v in points)])

    def read(self, frame, time_s):
        ego_s, ego_y = self.body(self.actors["ego"])
        target_s, target_y = self.body(self.actors["target"])
        speeds = {}
        for role in ("ego", "target"):
            v = self.actors[role].get_velocity()
            speeds[role] = math.sqrt(v.x ** 2 + v.y ** 2 + v.z ** 2)
        ego_station = sum(ego_s) / 2
        sections = self.site["cross_sections"]
        nearest = min(sections, key=lambda item: abs(item["station_m"] - ego_station))
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
               "ego_body_s_bounds_m": ego_s, "ego_body_y_bounds_m": ego_y,
               "target_body_s_bounds_m": target_s, "target_body_y_bounds_m": target_y,
               "ego_speed_mps": speeds["ego"], "target_speed_mps": speeds["target"],
               "paved_y_bounds_m": nearest["paved_y_bounds_m"],
               "paved_section_source": nearest["source_ref"],
               "actor_ids": [str(self.actors[r].id) for r in self.actors],
               "ego_position_xyz_m": [self.actors["ego"].get_location().x,
                                      self.actors["ego"].get_location().y,
                                      self.actors["ego"].get_location().z],
               "ego_heading_deg": self.actors["ego"].get_transform().rotation.yaw,
               "ego_control": {"throttle": self.actors["ego"].get_control().throttle,
                               "brake": self.actors["ego"].get_control().brake,
                               "steer": self.actors["ego"].get_control().steer}}
        if "conflict" in self.actors:
            row["conflict_body_s_bounds_m"], row["conflict_body_y_bounds_m"] = \
                self.body(self.actors["conflict"])
        return row

    def pixels(self, frame):
        from PIL import Image
        images = {}
        for name in CAMERA_NAMES:
            image = self.queues[name].get(timeout=10)
            need(image.frame == frame, "original camera frame differs: " + name)
            raw = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (image.width, image.height),
                                  bytes(image.raw_data), "raw", "BGRA")
            output = io.BytesIO()
            raw.convert("RGB").save(output, format="PNG")
            images[name] = {"frame": frame, "png": output.getvalue()}
        return images

    def cleanup(self):
        try:
            for role in ("ego", "target"):
                if role in self.actors:
                    self.actors[role].apply_control(self.carla.VehicleControl(brake=1))
        finally:
            for actor in reversed(self.owned):
                try:
                    actor.destroy()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.world.apply_settings(self.settings)
            need(self.world.get_settings().synchronous_mode == self.settings.synchronous_mode,
                 "Native world restoration failed")
